meta.name: Pavitra Rishta
meta.description:
An extraordinary love story of an ordinary couple, Manav and Archana, who overcome all challenges to come together in the sacred union of marriage.

Returning Series · First aired 15 Sept 2021 · India · Language: Hindi · 28 min
Studio: 24 Frames Media · Network: nabd alqalb studio, ZEE5

Not complete. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 not on server

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: A Brew Called Love
videos.overview: Archana is in dilemma after her best friend gets drunk and seeks Manav's help, who agrees to drop them home. Later, she gets embroiled in a cybercrime case, following which her wedding is called off.

videos.title: The 'Un'breakable Vow
videos.overview: To fix Manav's marriage, Savita tricks Archana's parents. Archana and Manav go on a date. The two are happy on their wedding day, but their dreams shatter when Sulochana learns the truth.

videos.title: Guilty and Charged
videos.overview: Archana and Manav are sad as their marriage is in shambles. Manav finds out about Varsha's affair and decides to inform Archana about it. Later, Archana plans to seek Manav's help in the matter.

videos.title: We Are a Team?
videos.overview: Archana and Manav go to Varsha's office to speak to Ashish about his and Varsha's affair. Manav comforts Archana after the fiasco at Varsha's office. Sulochana is determined to get Archana remarried.

videos.title: Loves Me, Loves Me Not!
videos.overview: Archana meets Gaurav for a date. Manav is distant from Archana, who decides to confess her feelings to him. Archana is shocked to see Sulochana, who tells her that the annulment will happen soon.

videos.title: Birthday Surprise
videos.overview: Manav is busy with his loan interview and forgets to meet Archana. Later, he goes to the cafe to meet Archana, but Ajit walks in, and the two hide in the pantry. Ajit locks the cafe and leaves.

videos.title: Dreams Unlimited
videos.overview: Archana and Manav spend a good time together in the cafe. Archana is shocked when Sulochana brings Satish's marriage proposal for her. Manav makes a tough decision.

videos.title: A Toast for Love
videos.overview: Archana and Satish get engaged, but Sulochana changes her mind. Manjusha files a complaint against Manav and his family. Archana meets Manav with a hope to reconcile, but she is in for a rude shock.
